summary: Feed s096_single is degraded: 82.5% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding IDS tolerance of 60% and blinding payload inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 83% of traffic is TLS-encrypted with no decryption in the visibility path before the IDS. The packet broker is forwarding encrypted flows directly to the tool, well above its 60% encrypted tolerance.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection. With 82.5% opaque payload, it cannot inspect application content, causing missed intrusions, high false-negatives and severely reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot analyze encrypted payloads. Add selective SSL/TLS decryption or offload bulk encrypted traffic in the packet broker so decrypted cleartext is delivered to the IDS and encrypted share drops below 60%.
